svg.title: The human sleep studies: who ran them, what they found
svg.desc: The human sleep studies: who ran them, what they found. 1981, Discovering group, Healthy volunteers, double-blind crossover, 6 people: Positive (authors). 1981, Discovering group, Insomnia, single doses, 6 people: Positive (authors). 1984, Other clinic, Insomnia, open-label, no control, 7 people: Positive (author), uncontrolled. 1986, Discovering group, Insomnia, no placebo group, 18 people: Positive (authors). 1987, Discovering group, Insomnia, placebo nights only (FDA puts 'placebo-controlled' in quotes), 14 people: Positive (authors). 1987, Independent, Insomnia, randomized double-blind placebo crossover, 6 people: Little clinical significance. 1992, Independent, Insomnia, double-blind placebo parallel groups, 16 people: Weak; not likely of major benefit.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
